title: Send the order to the lab or move it to the next stage
summary: Move an order to the next stage. When sending it to the lab, the due date comes already proposed in a window.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Search for the order
steps.details: Search by patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.details: Click it in the list. Its details open on the right.

steps.title: Current stage
steps.details: Which stage it is in, how many days it has been there and what is left.

steps.title: Send to the lab
steps.details: The sending window opens, with the due date already proposed.

steps.title: Move to the next stage
steps.details: If the order is already at the lab, this button moves it to the next stage. It saves when you click it.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: Only if it has no lab yet: it says so in red and won't confirm without one. If only one lab does that job, it comes preselected.

steps.title: When was it sent?
steps.details: If you sent it earlier and are only recording it now, tap Yesterday or Another day. Days in stage and the delivery date count from that day.

steps.title: Due date
steps.details: It comes proposed from the stage’s time limit. The three days, one week or two weeks shortcuts change it with one click. If the date passes and it has not arrived, the order becomes overdue and an alert goes out.

steps.title: Confirm the send
steps.details: Clicking it saves the stage change, with the lab and the date.

steps.title: Stage history
steps.details: Every change is recorded: who made it, when, and how long it was in the previous stage.
